verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, so the axis applies. Its site describes handing tasks to the assistant: drafting petitions and briefs, researching law changes, extracting PDF data into spreadsheets, reviewing RFEs for deadlines, translating intake forms, building exhibit lists and automating workflows, plus a 'Research Agent' in version 2.1. Missing for 10: detailed product documentation of how delegation and agentic workflows actually run, independent or hands-on confirmation, and clarity on how far multi-step automation goes beyond marketing example prompts.
